items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 06 October 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the Norwegian Sea, with high pressure over Central Europe, a cold front will slowly move south across the area today.


##Wind##

Northerly 2 to 4, increasing northwest 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 later tomorrow, decreasing 4 or 5 again overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate for a time, then slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
